author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam has accumulated over 10,000 miles Onewheel experience under his belt, but something he's never done is upgrade or swap out his Onewheel's tire. Based on the recommedation of Wren from Corridor Crew, Adam picks up a Float Life tire and makes an upgrade attempt. Disclaimer: this is not an instructional video! 

Onewheel Rally XL: https://onewheel.com/pages/onewheel-gt-s-series-rally-xl
Float Life Enduro Tire: https://thefloatlife.com/collections/onewheel-gt-accessories/products/enduro-tire
We tested the Fujifilm FGX Eterna 55 on this build video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4Lmaoz56zdI
Savage Industries Laptop Sleeve: https://adamsavage.com/collections/new-new-new/products/savage-industries-laptop-sleeve

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
